newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo in $190 mln China building JV.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo in $190 mln China building JV.

text.p: Daewoo Corp, a unit of Daewoo Group, said on Thursday it had agreed in principle with its Chinese and Korean partners to build a $190 million commercial building in north China.
"Construction is ... scheduled for completion by 2000," Daewoo spokesman Lee Jeong-weon said.

Leee said the construction division of Daewoo Corp would have a 57 percent stake in the project in the northeastern Chinese city of Tianjin, the city government of the South Korean city of Inchon would have 38 percent, and China's Tianjin Development Zone Co Ltd five percent.
The 51-storey building will comprise residential apartments, shops, offices and an exhibition centre.
